product_launches.description: A compliance management tool that automates processes, reduces regulatory risks, and enhances operational efficiency for financial institutions.

overview_description.description: Hadrius develops compliance management software for financial services firms that helps organizations oversee regulatory requirements through a unified platform. Its platform supports functions such as marketing review, communications archiving, trade surveillance, employee oversight, code of ethics management, and compliance program administration. The software uses artificial intelligence to automate compliance workflows, monitor communications and trading activity, and generate documentation for regulatory reviews. It is designed for broker-dealers, registered investment advisers, private funds, and compliance consulting firms that are subject to SEC and FINRA regulations. Hadrius also provides centralized tools that help organizations manage policies, supervision activities, risk monitoring, and audit records within a single system.

about_short_description.short_description: Hadrius is an AI-native compliance platform that centralizes compliance operations for financial firms.

product.name: Hadrius Compliance Platform
product.description: An AI-powered compliance operations platform that centralizes supervision, monitoring, testing, approvals, archiving, and audit evidence for SEC- and FINRA-regulated financial firms.

product.name: Testing Program
product.description: A compliance testing workspace for tracking risks, automating tests, documenting results, and generating audit-ready reports for regulated financial firms.

product.name: Marketing Review
product.description: An AI-assisted review service for evaluating financial marketing materials, recommending compliance changes, managing approvals, and maintaining disclosure consistency.

product.name: Communications Archiving
product.description: A communications supervision and archiving service for email, chat, and social channels that supports review, retention, escalation, and regulator-ready evidence.

product.name: Account Surveillance
product.description: A trade-monitoring service that evaluates employee and firm transactions against restricted lists, blackout periods, personal-trading rules, and configurable surveillance tests.

product.name: People Oversight
product.description: A workforce compliance service for monitoring personal trading, managing attestations and certifications, and handling employee compliance requests and disclosures.
